changes.before: suggests that the economic recovery is on a firmer footing, and overall conditions in the labor market appear to be improving gradually
changes.after: indicates that the economic recovery is proceeding at a moderate pace and overall conditions in the labor market are improving gradually

changes.before: Nonetheless, longer-term inflation expectations have remained stable, and measures of underlying inflation have been subdued.
changes.after: Inflation has picked up in recent months, but longer-term inflation expectations have remained stable and measures of underlying inflation are still subdued.

changes.before: The recent increases in the prices of energy and other commodities are currently putting upward pressure on inflation.
changes.after: Increases in the prices of energy and other commodities have pushed up inflation in recent months.

changes.before: intends to purchase $600 billion of longer-term Treasury securities by the end of the second quarter of 2011
changes.after: will complete purchases of $600 billion of longer-term Treasury securities by the end of the current quarter

changes.before: The Committee will regularly review the pace of its securities purchases and the overall size of the asset-purchase program in light of incoming information and will adjust the program as needed
changes.after: The Committee will regularly review the size and composition of its securities holdings in light of incoming information and is prepared to adjust those holdings as needed

changes.before: have contributed to a sharp run-up in oil prices in recent weeks
changes.after: have contributed to a further increase in oil prices since the Committee met in March

parsed.rationale: The statement acknowledges that inflation has actually picked up and signals that QE2 will end on schedule, shifting from purchase-pace review to holdings review, which leans modestly hawkish. These are offset only slightly by a softer growth description, while the 'extended period' rate guidance is unchanged.
